section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Case and Brake)
title: ASSEMBLY OF OVERDRIVE CASE AND BRAKE

content.description: Installation of two oil seal rings on overdrive case showing circular case with rings in groove

items.heading: INSTALL TWO OIL SEAL RINGS ON OVERDRIVE CASE
items.text: Spread the rings apart and slide them into the groove. Hook both ends by hand.

content.description: Installation of brake piston in overdrive case showing hands installing piston with cup side up

items.heading: INSTALL BRAKE PISTON IN OVERDRIVE CASE
items.text: Install the piston with cup side up, being careful not to damage the O-rings.

items.heading: INSTALL TWELVE RETURN SPRINGS AND SET RETAINER AND SNAP RING IN PLACE
items.text: Check that the ends of snap ring are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

content.description: Installation of thrust bearing and races showing ring gear assembly

items.heading: INSTALL THRUST BEARING AND RACES TO RING GEAR AND SET RING GEAR IN OVERDRIVE CASE
items.note: Make sure that the races are installed in correct direction.

content.description: Exploded view showing assembly order of cushion plate, discs, plates and flange

items.heading: INSTALL CUSHION PLATE, DISCS, PLATES AND FLANGE
items.text: Using low pressure compressed air, blow all excess ATF from the discs.
items.caution: High-pressure air will damage the discs.

items.heading: INSTALL SNAP RING
items.text: Check that the ends of the snap ring are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

content.text: High-pressure air will damage the discs.

content.description: Measuring brake clearance between snap ring and flange using feeler gauge

items.heading: MEASURE BRAKE CLEARANCE
items.text: Measure the distance between the snap ring and flange.

items.heading: KEEP THRUST WASHER FOR ASSEMBLY
items.text: The thrust washer left over will be installed later, as the transmission is assembled.
